comments.author: sdoering
comments.story: By 2030, 56 countries will have more people aged 65+ than children under 15
comments.text: Whenever I read things like this. I am reminded of Hans Rosling's "Global population growth, box by box"[1]. The only question is, how to transition to a "steady state economy"[2][3] or "non growth economies", when population really reaches some kind of equilibrium. As growth is the only concept humans for the last tens of thousands of years knew, this transition, while absolutely necessary, will be hard and hurt lots of people I believe. comments.why: Population tops out around 10 billion via reduced child mortality
comments.text: Hans Rosling seems to think we'll top out at 10 billion. [VIDEO] and the main mechanism is, counter-intuitively, reducing child mortality in the poorest areas.
